A long-term memory for coding agents, built on one ArchiMate 3.2 intent graph read/written through a single MCP interface.","id":"gh:1334179832","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"archgraph","slug":"derekhu0002/archgraph","topics":["agent-framework","agent-memory","agent-orchestration","agentic","agentic-ai","agents","archimate","copilot","cursor","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","enterprise-architect","graph-rag","knowledge-graph","long-term-memory","mcp","openclaw","opencode"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"ArchGraph — an architecture-graph driven framework for Agentic Engineering. A long-term memory for c"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"oding agents, built on one ArchiMate 3.2 intent graph read/written through a single MCP interface."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# ArchGraph"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**A knowledge-graph framework with an ontology you define — wired into your coding agent through one"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"ph framework with an ontology you define — wired into your coding agent through one MCP interface.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**English** · 简体中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"For teams running coding agents on a real codebase, ArchGraph gives the agent durable, tiered long-t"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"erm memory on an **intent graph** — a versioned architecture graph that records *why* the system is "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"built the way it is, not just how. You and the agent read and write it through a single **MCP** serv"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"er (**MCP** = **Model Context Protocol**, the open standard that lets an AI tool call external serve"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"rs as tools). The graph's shape is set by an **ontology** — its vocabulary of element and relationsh"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"ip types — and that ontology is yours to define. The built-in default is **ArchiMate 3.2 + ARGO exte"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"nsions**, where **ArchiMate** is a standard enterprise-architecture modeling language and **ARGO** i"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"s the toolchain and agent-workflow layer behind the `argo-deploy` and `argo-init` commands. A reposi"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"tory can plug in its own ontology — and this one does. **One install, one interface to learn.**"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Ready to try it? Jump to **Build your own graph**."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Install · Build your own graph · Why ArchGraph · Capabilities · Docs · Community"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## What is this?"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"If you run coding agents on a real codebase, every session starts cold and the "why" behind the syst"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"em lives nowhere. ArchGraph makes **one architecture graph** the single source of truth — the agent'"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"s memory and the product's design in one model. It is *one MCP interface* to install and learn: the "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"agent restores context at session start, recalls detail on demand, and reuses what it already knows "},{"id":"p9s5","text":"instead of duplicating it (a duplicate needs an explicit override)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Architects / tech leads** — one model of the product, the harness, and the agents.
- **Agent use"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"rs** — memory restored at session start, recalled on demand, reused instead of duplicated.
- **Platf"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"orm teams** — one interface, deployed into the editor you already use."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"→ Full onboarding: **docs/getting-started.html**"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Why ArchGraph"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Every team running coding agents hits the same wall: the code is in the repo, but the *reasoning* be"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"hind it lives nowhere. Four common fixes exist, and each works until it doesn't."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The real differentiator is **not** "custom vs. locked". Protégé/OWL, Neo4j, TerminusDB, and Archi/EA"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" all let you extend a model or bring your own vocabulary. It is that ArchGraph makes the ontology a "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"**first-class, validated, runtime-resolved schema bundle** — and puts it behind **one MCP interface*"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"* the agent reads *and* writes, with typed dedup and commit traceability built in."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The honest, cost-included comparison lives in one canonical place — **docs/capabilities.html#compare"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" honest, cost-included comparison lives in one canonical place — **docs/capabilities.html#compare**."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Bring your own ontology"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"A knowledge-graph framework that speaks only one language is not a framework. ArchGraph separates th"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"e **core** from the **ontology**: a repository drops a *schema bundle* under `.argo/schema/` (elemen"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"t/relationship types, endpoint rules, an actor contract, an optional guide), and validation, MCP gui"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"dance, and the `.qea` projection follow it. A bundle can `extends: "default"` — inheriting the built"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"-in **ArchiMate 3.2 + ARGO extensions** — and add its own types; no framework change required."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"This repository is the proof: its own bundle uses `extends: "default"` and layers a **UML 2 state-ma"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"chine profile** on top, resolved at runtime from `.argo/schema/` rather than hardcoded in the framew"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"e profile** on top, resolved at runtime from `.argo/schema/` rather than hardcoded in the framework."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"→ Worked example — define an ontology, then build the graph step by step: **docs/case-team-graph.htm"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"l** · prebuilt ontology catalog: `custom-schema/` (Team Graph · Finance CDM · Industry 4.0 AAS · STI"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"X Threat Intelligence · UML 2 · SysML · IPD · Mathematics) · full authoring reference (types, relati"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"onship structure, axioms/constraints): **docs/ontology-authoring.md**"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Ontology validation (optional)"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Your schema bundle already enforces endpoint rules. ArchGraph can go further and run a **real ontolo"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"gy / reasoning engine** at the same validation timings the framework already uses — **on write** (th"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"e change's delta subgraph) and **at init** (the whole graph) — to catch what a schema alone cannot:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **logical contradictions** (OWL inconsistency — e.g. an element that is two disjoint types, or a s"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ingle-valued slot with two values), and
- **constraint violations** (SHACL, compiled from your endpo"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" slot with two values), and
- **constraint violations** (SHACL, compiled from your endpoint matrix)."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"It is **opt-in and off by default**; when enabled it is **fail-close** — a configured-but-unavailabl"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"e engine is a **blocking error**, not a silent pass (an advisory validator can opt out per entry wit"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"h `onError: "warn"`)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"**Enable it.**"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Capabilities"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Each line links to a short page — this is the map, not the manual."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **Tiered long-term memory** — a compact working memory at session start, a long-term memory recall"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ed on demand, and an archive.
- **Pluggable ontology** — ship your own schema bundle; the default (A"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"rchiMate 3.2 + ARGO extensions) is data, not code.
- **Semantic + structural retrieval** — Graph RAG"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" recall plus read-only Cypher for exact structure.
- **Deduplicated writes** — reuse an existing ele"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"ment, relationship, or view instead of copying it; near-duplicates are blocked as candidates.
- **Ac"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"ceptance-test-first + traceability** — every change is testable, and the commit id is registered bac"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"k onto the element.
- **Enterprise Architect interop** — the graph projects to `.qea`; human EA edit"},{"id":"p29s8","text":"s return as a semantic diff.
- **Federated graph sharing** — sovereign graphs joined by a registry–b"},{"id":"p29s9","text":"roker; reads authorized and returned by reference.
- **One MCP interface, six hosts** — install once"},{"id":"p29s10","text":", run in Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode, DeepSeek Harness, OpenClaw, and Codex."}],"truncated":true}
